$description: Apollo Legacy override set (ADR-0011: themes = override sets at the semantic tier). Per-mode values Legacy re-binds OVER the Mono base; any path absent here falls back to Mono. Consumed by canon/gen_theme_cascade.py, which generates the [data-apollo-theme="legacy"] cascade into canon.css (AUTO-THEMES block) — root-level canonical vars + per-component vars via each snippet's #token-manifest. Never hand-edit canon.css; edit THIS file and re-run the generator. Every override carries $note provenance: these values are reconstructed from the R-D16/R-D18/R-D20 eviction records and the Legacy-era roles still in the store, NOT invented. Authored 2026-07-21 (build-out Phase 0); extended as Phase-1 per-component finalisation surfaces more Legacy-owned roles.

button/primary/background/default.$note: Legacy brand-red CTA (R-D19: #DB0011 is Legacy's alone). Source: the Legacy-era primary/background/default role still in the store. Mono base is the monochrome ink ladder (B-D1: no red).

button/primary/background/pressed.$note: Source: primary/background/pressed (Legacy pressed flips to black/white — same as Mono).

button/primary/background/disabled.$note: Source: primary/background/disabled. Same values as Mono today; declared so Legacy's disabled state is pinned independently of future Mono edits.

button/primary/label/default.$note: White label on the red CTA, both modes (Legacy convention; cf. text/reverse). Mono's label flips by mode (text/on-inverse).

button/primary/icon/default.$note: White icon on the red CTA, mirroring label/default. Dave #170 (s170-D4): the sibling label was overridden at s131-D1 but the icon was not — the gap surfaced when the audit's state-pairing fix (s170-D3) stopped masking it (mono #333333 on #DB0011 = 2.42:1).

rag/success-tint.$note: The pre-R-D18 teal tint pair, named in rag/success-tint's own eviction note ('was #E5F2F2 / #001615').

rag/warning-tint.$note: Pre-R-D20 amber tint pair, named in rag/warning-tint's eviction note ('was #FFF8EA / #221701').

rag/information-tint.$note: Pre-R-D20 blue tint pair, named in rag/information-tint's eviction note ('was #EBEFF4 / #000D1B').

progress/complete.$note: Evicted from the Mono base 2026-07-21 (Dave, Phase-1: 'resolve this to the newer red status color' — worker-A receipt F3; reconfirmed same evening on the harness: 'the colours in legacy … are fine'). Pre-eviction base values (were $alias color/primary, flat #DB0011 both modes). R-D19: #DB0011 is Legacy's alone.

badge/background.$note: Dave 2026-07-21, badge ruling on the harness (verbatim): 'the colours are fine apart from Legacy, it should be the legacy primary red on both light and dark.' Brand-PRIMARY red flat, deliberately NOT the Legacy error pair — that is why the badge/background component slot exists. Known fidelity condition: white numeral on #DB0011 ≈ 4.02:1 (< 4.5 text) — same Legacy-fidelity-vs-AA family as text/on-success white-on-teal, queued for Dave with that item.

text/default.$note: Legacy body ink = Grey 8 #333333 (col25-011: 'white or Grey 8 ONLY'). R-D16 superseded this FOR MONO (mono/4 #1A1A1A) and records 'Grey-8 = Legacy'.

text/secondary.$note: Directly instructed by text/secondary's R-D16 note: 'Legacy retains the dimmer #545454/#9B9B9B as its own theme override.' Mono collapses secondary to the single ink.

border/subtle.$note: Legacy hairline pair (color/grey/300 light) — the pre-R-D16 store values, still documented in the canon.css alias comments. Mono seats borders on the mono ramp (#E1E1E1/#808080).

border-radius/default.$note: Dave 2026-07-21: Legacy = square, same as Mono.

tabs/active.$note: R-D23: Legacy keeps the as-built red bar, both modes (eviction record — this hex left the Mono base for this override the same day). R-D24 posture: faithful reproduction.

tabs/inactive.$note: R-D23: Legacy mechanism = none — no operational fade; inactive label carries the as-built body ink (grey/800 light), bar-only differentiation.

motion/press/travel.$note: B-D7 (Dave 2026-07-22): press/hover MOVEMENT is ABSENT in Legacy — state feedback is colour-only (the as-built system has no scale physics; R-D24 reproduction posture). travel=0 makes scale(calc(1 ± 0/size)) the identity. Theme dial — raise if finessing ever wants it.

motion/press/darken.$note: B-D7: no :active brightness darken in Legacy — the pressed colour tokens carry the state. brightness(1) = no-op.

rag/error-tint.$note: s123-D3 (Dave, 2026-08-07, #123): legacy error TINT declared — was the ONLY legacy tint never declared (success/warning/information were), so it would have fallen through to mono's new alpha-derived composite: the same accidental fall-through class as s123-D1/ds-039. Values from rag/error-tint's own eviction note ('was #F9F2F3 / #260005'). Per-mode, matching legacy's three sibling tint overrides.

text/on-success.$note: s131-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-08, #131): the flip-only-if-ruled condition (recorded in rag/success-background's note) is NOW RULED - reversed white text and marks on legacy success. Measured white on #00847F = 4.56:1 AA-pass. NOTE: the old note's 3.47:1 figure does not reproduce against #00847F; discrepancy declared, not silently corrected.

rag/text/on-information.$note: s131-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-08, #131): legacy info fill is DARK (#305A85) so info text/marks reverse to white (7.17:1). Theme half of the info-ink mint; base slot lives in semantic-colour.json and defaults to the dark on-light ink.

$marksNote: s122-D5 (Dave, #122): verbatim 'on the legacy lane, the glyphs should all be white, apart from amber'. Mode-invariant. Needed because the base mark atoms went #1A1A1A x4 under s122-D2 and Legacy would otherwise inherit them.

error.$note: s122-D5: knockout on the Legacy error fill #A8000B.

warning.$note: s122-D5: knockout on the Legacy warning fill #FFBB33.

success.$note: s122-D5: knockout on the Legacy success fill #00847F.

info.$note: s122-D5: knockout on the Legacy info fill #305A85.

$guardsNote: s158-D1 (Dave, #158): GUARDS. Not token overrides — declarations that THIS theme keeps a paint a later MONO-ONLY ruling moved away from it. They were hand-edited into canon.css's AUTO-THEMES block (which says do NOT hand-edit), and that is what held gen_theme_cascade --check red. Sourced here so the generator emits them and canon.css is clean generated output again. Provenance: .cn-banner .banner.err ink + .cn-tabs --badge-bg/--badge-ink = s149-D1 clauses (1) and (3), scoped 'this is right for mono only' — legacy s131-D1 / console+supercharge s132-D1 stay as built; --error-atom: var(--error) = s151-D1, an explicit NO-OP guard so the two-red law's atom fork cannot reach a theme that owns its own red. placement 'sorted' joins the sorted declaration namespace, 'append' is emitted after it in authored order (both reproduce the ratified bytes).
